item_short_desc: Rothco’s Kids Adjustable Camo Cap offers both style and functionality for children. This baseball-style cap is designed to fit most kids comfortably with its adjustable strap. Constructed from a comfortable 55% cotton / 45% polyester fabric blend, it ensures durability and breathability, making it ideal for everyday use and outdoor activities. Available in multiple camo patterns and colors, this camouflage baseball cap allows kids to express their individual style while staying protected from the sun.
